Power Station | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 on main transformer 422 MVA-22/220kv, 
 which must 
 be performed on yearly bases or every two years 
 as 
 indicated by Y1/Y2 in the title block.
Technical 
 Specification
3 phase set up Transformer
Rated power | 422 MVA | Type of tap changer | off 
 load
Rated frequency | 50HZ | Weight of oil | 60 ton
Rated voltage | LV: 22 KV HV: 241+/- 42.5% K.V | Weight of transformer (with oil ) | 353 ton
Type of cooling: | ONAN / ONAF / OFAF | Year of service | 3/5/1990
Winding connection | Y Nd11 |  | 
The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Kamal Oshbah, tested by eng. Reda 
 Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, approved by eng. 
 Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station and certified by eng. 
 Sania Diab Attia Diab : WDEPC Inspection head sector 
 and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A 
 work permit must be issued.
The 
 qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear 
 safety and healthy equipments as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc
The transformer must be was isolated and proper grounding is required.
Prepare necessary tools and spare parts after due planning.
Before commencing work make sure that the machine is isolated from 
 the power supply and make sure again by making use of electric detector that 
 the circuit is dead.
Ground transformer bushing terminals while working on the 
 transformer, these instructions such as internal inspection please ask before 
 commencing work make sure that the machine is isolated from the power supply 
 and make sure again by making use of electric detector that the circuit is 
 dead.
There is a danger of falling into the oil containments pit when working near 
 large power transformers.
There is danger of falling off the top of the transformer when cleaning 
 insulator, wear safety belt.
